summary: Up 0.1 from w12 (8.4) and on the 8.5 target, with no high-severity issues. The w12 medium blocker is fixed: the trim-A back weave has its contrast back. The p8 back measures p10/p50 0.77, p90/p50 1.30 and high-pass SD 0.181, against py_37301's 0.71 / 1.25 / 0.179 (w12 was 0.83 / 1.19 / 0.123). The q14 near back measures 0.77 / 1.28 / 0.170 (w12 0.82 / 1.18 / 0.115). The literature pocket is now very close to b_san_26 (q13b left seat, p2, p6). The recess is about 0.63 of the frame width, the tray sits at its foot, and the mesh band follows the smile directly under the rim. The gooseneck hose now reads as a hose (about 0.4-0.45 of the head width, against about 0.45-0.5 in py_37305). The petal tile is now 2-3:1 slivers with no round specks, and the ear chip cover is 0.139 against 0.161 in py_37305. Three things remain. (1) Medium: at studio and cabin distance the trim-A weave reads as random 'TV static' speckle, not the ordered brick-row lattice with dark gaps in py_37301 / 37303. The contrast numbers match, but the structure does not (montage w13b/fab_montage.png). (2) Low: the trim-B back petals are still too sparse (bright cover 0.058 against 0.091 on the py_37302 foreground back, unchanged from w12's 0.057). On the ears the thin slivers have drifted away from py_37305's chunkier angular, notched chips. (3) Low: the studio cushion is still washed out (S 0.10, high-pass SD 0.089, against 0.17 / 0.161 in py_37301), the bezel is still darker than py_37304 (#0f1116 against #282932), and the safety card is a blank pale square.
lighting_note: Not scored. The sun diamond is still on the 26B back in q14 (about x 490-550, y 310-400). The studio p8 top-lit cushions wash toward grey-white (ACES shoulder). The q13 trim-B back mean is #606a80 (S 0.25), darker and greyer than py_37302's foreground #697a9f (S 0.34), which is a cooler-lit photo. As before, the q13b foreground (navy band, magnified dashes, big ear chips) comes from the camera sitting inside the seat ahead, so it is not scored.

issues.issue: At studio and cabin distance (p1, p8, q14) the trim-A weave reads as random 'TV static': bright specks scattered with no row order, each block broken up by thread speckle. py_37301 / 37303 show an ordered lattice: rows of near-uniform pale blocks of similar length with visible dark gaps (mortar) between them and a steady row pitch. The contrast statistics now match, so the remaining mismatch is the structure.
issues.evidence: Montage w13b/fab_montage.png at 3x: 1 = py_37301 back, 2 = w13 p8 back, 4 = py_37301 cushion, 5 = w13 p8 cushion. p8 back hpSD 0.181 against 0.179 and p90/p50 1.30 against 1.25 (match), but the photo blocks are flat and crisp-edged while ours are internally speckled and fuzzy-edged. q14 near back (x 260-380) reads as noise at 930x575; py_37303 reads as calm fine bricks.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back. (1) Row pitch jitter: rng.normal(1, 0.18, rows) -> rng.normal(1, 0.08, rows), and yc jitter +-0.12 -> +-0.06 ph, giving steady rows. (2) Light-band edge divisor /1.3 -> /0.9 for crisper block tops and bottoms. Dash length N(19, 7) clip 8-32 -> N(21, 4) clip 14-28, so the blocks are similar in length and the gaps read as mortar. (3) Flatter blocks inside: `lite *= 0.7 + 0.55 * thr` -> `lite *= 0.88 + 0.22 * thr`. To keep the back near p90/p50 1.25-1.30 and hpSD 0.17-0.19, raise `1 + 1.9 * lite` -> `1 + 2.1 * lite`. Re-measure p8 back (box 420,40,560,180) and q14 near back (260,290,380,440).
